_comment: Deliberately short list — established Nepali newsrooms with a real editorial desk, plus RONB for banda/strike alerts. Aggregators, republishers and outlets whose feeds have gone stale were removed: more sources meant more duplicates and more junk, not better coverage. Every `feed` here was probed live and its item count recorded in `_verified`. RONB is read through scrapers/ronbScraper.js (Meta Graph API or an RSS bridge you configure), not through a feed URL — see .env.example.

sources.name: RONB
sources._why: Routine of Nepal Banda — first to report bandas, chakka jams, road closures and curfews, which is exactly what this server needs same-day. Birthday and sponsor posts get roasted instead of reported.

sources.name: Kathmandu Post
sources._why: Kantipur Media Group's English daily — the most consistently sourced English reporting in Nepal, and its pages carry full article bodies the summariser can read.

sources.name: Setopati
sources._why: Largest independent Nepali-language newsroom; breaks political stories ahead of the English dailies.

sources.name: Online Khabar English
sources._why: High-volume English desk with good coverage of business, tech and Kathmandu civic news.

sources.name: The Annapurna Express
sources._why: Weekly with longer analysis pieces — thin on breaking news, useful for context in the evening recap.

sources.name: The Rising Nepal
sources._why: Gorkhapatra Sansthan's English daily — state-run, so it carries official notices and government decisions verbatim.
